title: Codex Actor Integration Parameters
description: Configures Codex for one actor and local integration.

sandbox.description: Requests the Codex filesystem sandbox. Defaults to danger-full-access. The trusted host must name the canonical workspace path in CWR_CODEX_DANGER_FULL_ACCESS_WORKSPACE; local runtimes grant their bound workspace automatically. Use workspace-write to opt down.

cwr_only.description: Disable provider filesystem, process, and network tools while retaining the actor's CWR host tools. Requires cwr_action_actor_refs. Defaults to false.

cwr_action_actor_refs.description: Limit CWR actions to exact concrete coworkers. Declaration-local aliases resolve to canonical coworker refs during activation.
